rationale: This qualitative dissertation examines collaborative inter-agency and public governance of Philadelphia's Green City, Clean Waters green stormwater infrastructure program to reduce imperviousness and stormwater runoff into combined sewers, focusing on deliberative democracy in policymaking. Because it concerns urban stormwater runoff management rather than household or community drinking water or sanitation service access (E07) and measures no water/sanitation access outcome, it is excluded.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both readings because Criterion 1 (service access) and Criterion 4 (access outcome) fail: the dissertation examines urban stormwater runoff management via green infrastructure and deliberative democratic policymaking rather than household or community water or sanitation service access.
